Name: Pelipper Expander PokeManager
Author: SonSDT
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Pelipper Expander PokeManager[/b][/size]
[size=3][i]One window to manage every Pokémon Hut around your chest[/i][/size]
[size=3][b]Newest Version 0.5.6 | Last 0.3.1[/b][/size][/center]

[line]

[center][size=6][b][color=#e8a317]★ BIG UPDATE: WHAT'S NEW IN 0.5.5 ★[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Smooth FPS all day  •  Pokémon load items into your chests  •  a queue that really empties[/b][/size][/center]

[b]Why this update matters:[/b] with dozens of huts the game could crawl at 1-2 FPS once Pokémon started heading home, and a chest queue could sit full forever. Both are fixed. The lag does not come from this mod. It is a loop inside [b]Pelipper Town 1.2.7[/b]: a Pokémon whose way home is blocked (by another Pokémon, a villager or you) asks for a new path search [b]every tick[/b], forever. 0.5.5 stops that loop from the outside. Pelipper Town is not changed or redistributed.

[size=4][b][color=#e8a317]Highlights[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Pokémon load items into chests:[/b] pick one or several chests per hut, give them names, and held items go there instead of to you.[/*]
[*][b]Stack + queue:[/b] huts with 6+ items wait for their turn. A hut that cannot be emptied (chest full, missing, too far) no longer blocks the others, and it retries after 5 s, 10 s, 20 s, up to 30 s.[/*]
[*][b]Return-loop guard:[/b] a blocked Pokémon waits longer between searches and, after a few seconds, is sent back to its hut.[/*]
[*][b]Search smoothing:[/b] "find work" and "stroll" searches (4-10 ms each, about 60 Pokémon) share one search per tick instead of piling into one frame.[/*]
[*][b]Chest picker fixes:[/b] the extra "ghost" tick box is gone, and a painted chest shows its colour as a thin bar on the row edge.[/*]
[*][b]New console tools:[/b] [font=Courier New]pe_route[/font] (why a hut is waiting), [font=Courier New]pe_stall[/font] (what the guard did), [font=Courier New]pe_profile[/font] (timing report).[/*]
[/list]

[i]How this was measured: the built-in [font=Courier New]pe_profile[/font], in 10-second windows where the huts were being updated (52, 54 and 82 windows). One save, 59 huts, about 60 working Pokémon, around 52 mods, SMAPI 4.5.2, Stardew Valley 1.6.15. "FPS" is how many frames were really drawn per second, not an update counter. The three sessions cover different times of day (06:40-21:20, 19:00-23:10 and 06:00-20:50), so read this as a real-world comparison, not a lab benchmark. Your numbers will differ.[/i]

[size=4][b][color=#e8a317]Upgrading[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Replace the mod folder and [b]keep your config.json[/b]. New settings are added automatically with safe defaults.[/*]
[*]Nothing else to do. The fixes are always on, and the console commands are only for looking.[/*]
[*]The SMAPI log should say [i]"Hut return-loop guard installed"[/i] and [i]"Hut search smoothing installed"[/i]. If a future Pelipper Town changes the code these hook into, the mod logs a warning and leaves Pelipper Town untouched.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b][color=#e8a317]Description[/color][/b][/size]

[b]Pelipper Expander PokeManager[/b] is a companion mod for [b]Pelipper Town[/b]. It adds a clean [b]Pokémon Manager[/b] window next to your Pokémon Chest, so you can look after dozens of Pokémon Huts without walking to each one. It can also send what your Pokémon carry straight into the chests you choose, and it keeps big farms running smoothly.

It does [b]not[/b] change or redistribute Pelipper Town. Every assign, unassign, chore and delivery change goes through Pelipper Town's own hut commands, so all of its rules still apply (blocked doors, water-only Pokémon, one resident per hut, owner checks). If something is refused, you get a readable reason instead of a silent failure.

[size=5][b][color=#e8a317]Installation instructions[/color][/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI 4.x[/b] and [b]Pelipper Town 1.2.7 or newer[/b] (with the mods it requires, such as SpaceCore).[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it.[/*]
[*]Copy the folder [b]pelipper_expander_pokemanager[/b] into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].[/*]
[*]Start the game through SMAPI. The SMAPI log should say that Pelipper Town was detected and that the bridge was validated.[/*]
[*]Stand within 3 tiles of a [b]Pokémon Chest[/b] and press [b]K[/b] (rebindable) to open the Manager.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b][color=#e8a317]Main features[/color][/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Evolve tab[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Lists every boxed Pokémon that Pelipper Town would let evolve, with avatars for the Pokémon and its evolution target(s).[/*]
[*]Evolve one, or evolve all ready Pokémon one after another. Pelipper Town's own evolution dialogue is used, so route choices and animations stay intact.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Huts tab[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Overview:[/b] every Pokémon Hut inside the managed area, with position, distance, resident, HP and energy bars, chore chips and item delivery.[/*]
[*][b]Detail panel:[/b] click a hut to toggle each chore and to switch item delivery between the chest and you. Chores a Pokémon cannot do are marked with a red X.[/*]
[*][b]Search, filter, sort:[/b] search by name, species or x,y. Filter by Empty / Occupied, delivery target and chores ("Has all": a Pokémon must be able to do [i]all[/i] the chosen chores). Sort by position, distance, name, level or energy.[/*]
[*][b]Assign:[/b] a large picker with accent-insensitive search, sorting, minimum level, chore filter and a picture of every Pokémon. Pokémon that cannot be placed are dimmed, with the reason.[/*]
[*][b]Unassign / Unassign all:[/b] unassign all asks for confirmation.[/*]
[*][b]Template and sync:[/b] set a hut as template, then sync its chores, delivery and chests to all huts or only the ticked ones.[/*]
[*][b]Safe batch actions:[/b] they never stop at the first problem and report "N ok, M failed (most common reason)".[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Quick assign in 3 steps[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Tick the empty huts you want to fill, then press [b]Quick assign[/b]. A green box next to the button shows it is on.[/*]
[*]Choose the chores in the [b]Has all[/b] filter. While Quick assign is on, this filter only picks the Pokémon and does not hide any huts.[/*]
[*]Press the button again. Free Pokémon that can do every chosen chore fill the ticked huts, and the list switches to [b]All[/b] so you can see who was placed.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Target chests: items go where you want them[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Open the picker:[/b] select a hut and press [b]Chest...[/b], or click the chest chip on its row. It lists the vanilla chests around the hut (Chest, Stone Chest, Big Chest, Big Stone Chest).[/*]
[*][b]Choose:[/b] click rows to pick several chests, [b]Name[/b] to name a chest (also available inside the game's own chest menu), [b]Apply[/b] to save, [b]No chest[/b] to return to Pelipper Town's original behaviour.[/*]
[*][b]Each row shows:[/b] name, type, paint colour, slots used and how many huts use that chest.[/*]
[*][b]Order of delivery:[/b] an item goes first to a chest that already holds it, so stacks grow and chests stay sorted, then to the other chosen chests in the order you picked them.[/*]
[*][b]Queue:[/b] huts with 6+ items join a queue. One batch every 3 seconds empties up to 8 huts. Items waiting for a delivery to you are never touched. All of this is adjustable.[/*]
[*][b]Range:[/b] a chest must be within [font=Courier New]RouteMaxDistanceTiles[/font] (default 100) of its hut when both are in the same place. A chest in another loaded location, such as a shed, has no distance limit.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Radius up to 100 tiles[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The managed area is a radius around the chest: [b]5 = 11x11[/b] tiles, [b]100 = 201x201[/b] tiles.[/*]
[*]Use the -10 / -1 / +1 / +10 buttons or type a number and press Enter.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Lag guard (0.5.4, improved in 0.5.5)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Breaks the blocked-Pokémon loop of Pelipper Town 1.2.7 and spreads its find-work and stroll searches over several ticks. Numbers are in the spotlight above.[/*]
[*]Works by patching three private Pelipper Town methods at run time (go home, find work, stroll). Nothing is copied, and any error inside the guard falls back to the original behaviour.[/*]
[*]Tip: when a Pokémon is sent home, the SMAPI log names the tile. If it is the same tile again and again (a narrow gap, a pond edge, a crowded doorway), widening that spot removes the cause.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Vietnamese language option[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Turn on [b]Vietnamese[/b] in the settings to show the whole Manager in Vietnamese.[/*]
[*]A bundled pixel font (VT323) makes sure every Vietnamese letter displays correctly. Pokémon names and nicknames are not translated, and Lv / HP / id stay as they are.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Settings[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Edit [b]config.json[/b], use [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (optional), or use the SMAPI console: [font=Courier New]pe_config[/font], [font=Courier New]pe_set <Key> <Value>[/font], [font=Courier New]pe_reset[/font], [font=Courier New]pe_range <radius>[/font].[/*]
[*]Values are clamped to safe limits and apply immediately, no restart needed.[/*]
[*][b]Lag guard:[/b] [font=Courier New]FixHutReturnLoop[/font] (true), [font=Courier New]SmoothHutSearches[/font] (true), [font=Courier New]HutSearchesPerTick[/font] (1), [font=Courier New]HutUnstickAfterRetries[/font] (4, 0 = never send a blocked Pokémon home).[/*]
[*][b]Chests:[/b] [font=Courier New]EnableRouting[/font], [font=Courier New]RouteMinItems[/font] (6), [font=Courier New]RouteIntervalTicks[/font] (180), [font=Courier New]RouteMaxHutsPerBatch[/font] (8), [font=Courier New]RouteMaxDistanceTiles[/font] (100).[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Console commands (for looking, not needed for the fixes)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]pe_huts[/font]: how many huts were found in range.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]pe_stall[/font]: what the lag guard did (go-home searches let through and held back, Pokémon sent home, searches pushed to a later tick).[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]pe_route[/font]: how many huts carry items, which are held back and why, with the chest's used/total slots.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]pe_profile on[/font] / [font=Courier New]off[/font]: times Pelipper Town's hut code and prints a report every 10 s. It adds a little overhead while on, so turn it off afterwards.[/*]
[*]The [font=Courier New]searches pushed to a later tick[/font] counter in [font=Courier New]pe_stall[/font] grows very fast on a big farm. That is normal, no search is lost.[/*]
[*]Tip: some FPS counters count game updates, not drawn frames, and can look healthy while the screen crawls. Use an overlay such as RivaTuner or MSI Afterburner for the real frame rate.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b][color=#e8a317]Requirements[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 and [b]SMAPI 4.x[/b][/*]
[*][b]Pelipper Town 1.2.7 or newer[/b] (and the mods it requires, such as SpaceCore)[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu [i](optional, for in-game settings)[/i][/*]
[/list]
[i]Multiplayer note: Pelipper Town requires the player to stand within 3 tiles of a hut. On the host or in single player the Manager handles this for you. A farmhand can only manage huts they are standing next to. Chest routing runs on the host / single player only.[/i]
